title: AirPrompter edge generation pointer
description: `generation.json` served from S3 behind CloudFront at an unguessable per-target path (D21, D59). A few hundred bytes, no prompt text; idle instances poll it and fetch the authorized manifest only when `generation` moved. Written with `Cache-Control: max-age=30` and invalidated on every promotion, so propagation is bounded by 30 s plus the poll interval.

generation.description: The pointer is first written by the first promotion, so it is never 0.
